install_output_empty: Leai se galuega faatino. O laina laina mai le meafaigaluega faʻapipiʻi o le a faʻaalia iinei.
linux_setup_title: Fa'apipi'i Meafaigaluega Fa'amalama Linux & SP Flash
linux_setup_welcome: Seti SP Flash Tool mo Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Si'itia ma fa'atutuina le afi fa'a'emo'e televave ina ia mafai ai ona e toe fa'afo'isia ma fa'afou lau ta'aloga e aunoa ma se taumafaiga.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek meafaigaluega fa'amalama fa'atasi ma le fa'aogaina o faletusi lautele fa'atulagaina.
linux_card_usb_desc: Tuuina atu le faatagaga i luga o le komepiuta e fesootai ai ma le tagata taalo ile faiga Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Su'esu'ega
system_checker_desc: Fa'amaonia atoatoa o aveta'avale, kernel modules, fa'atagaga, ma faletusi ta'avale e fa'amautinoa le fa'atuatuaina emo.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Saunia lau komepiuta e fa'afeso'ota'i i lau ta'aalo mo fa'afouga polokalame.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Siaki le faʻatulagaina o Linux mo le SP Flash Tool, faʻaogaina USB, faʻatagaga faʻasologa, ma vaega o le polokalama.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Saunia lau komepiuta e fa'afeso'ota'i i lau ta'aloga ma fa'apipi'i fa'afouga fa'apolokalame ma le fa'atuatuaina.
settings_checker_desc: Saunia lau komepiuta e fa'afeso'ota'i i lau ta'aloga ma fa'apipi'i fa'afouga fa'apolokalame ma le fa'atuatuaina.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Ua sauni lau komepiuta e fa'afeso'ota'i i lau ta'alo.
linux_prep_ready: Sauni, SP Flash Tool ua saunia.
linux_prep_connected_friendly: Ua maua le tagata taalo, toe fa'afouina le avanoa feso'ota'iga...
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: E mafai ona e fa'afeso'ota'i lau ta'alo pe a fesiligia.
linux_prep_blocked: E le mafai e lenei komepiuta ona faʻaogaina le SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: E mana'omia tasi lau fa'aupuga e fa'atūina ai le komepiuta lenei mo le fa'amalama: o tulafono USB mo masini MediaTek ma fa'aoga laina telefoni.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Ina ia setiina lenei komipiuta mo SP Flash Tool, o le a manaʻomia lau faʻaupuga i le isi laasaga e faʻapipiʻi tulafono USB ma faʻaopoopo lau tala i vaega manaʻomia faʻaoga faʻaoga. Afai e te teena, o le a tapunia le talosaga.
linux_prep_needs_access: E le'i fa'atagaina le avanoa, e mana'omia e moli.
linux_prep_fixed: Fa'atagaina avanoa, SP Flash Tool ua sauni.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Ua mae'a le seti ma ua fa'aopoopo lau tala i vaega fa'aoga e mana'omia mo le SP Flash Tool. Faamolemole toe amata lau komepiuta ina ia aoga faatagaga fou, ona toe tatala lea o le app. Kiliki le fa'ailoga e tapuni ai loa le app.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Ua uma, tapuni le App e toe amata le komepiuta
settings_driver_desc: Aʻo leʻi faʻaaogaina le app mo le taimi muamua, e tatau ona e faʻapipiʻi le MediaTek USB avetaʻavale, ona toe faʻafou lea o lau komepiuta.
home_desc: Su'e firmware i luga ole laiga pe filifili se afifi i le lotoifale, ona emo lea i lau masini.
sel_source_desc: La'u mai le firmware i luga ole laiga, pe fa'aulufale mai se afifi fa'apitonu'u.
settings_advanced_desc: Fa'aali auala fa'apipi'i, faiga fa'apipi'i ma fa'amama fa'amama.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install: Ta'ita'i a'u ile fa'apipi'i ile app
settings_guided_install_desc: E tumau le app ia oe e ala i le tapeina o le eletise, fesoʻotaʻi, ma faʻapipiʻi.
settings_sp_gui_install: Faʻapipiʻi ile SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Tapuni le Updater ma tatala le SP Flash Tool GUI ma le faila faʻasalalau faʻasalalau filifilia ma ata vaeluaga na muaʻi faʻapipiʻiina.
settings_terminal_desc: Fa'aola lau fa'apipi'i polokalame i le Terminal ina ia mafai ona e va'ai fa'amatalaga fa'apitoa ile alualu i luma.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Fa'asolo lau fa'apipi'i polokalame i le Command Prompt ina ia mafai ona e va'ai fa'amatalaga fa'apitoa ile alualu i luma.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Filifili. O nisi o sini MediaTek e mumusu e moli seiloga ua tuuina atu le SP Flash Tool se faila faʻamaonia (.auth); fa'aopoopo lau oe iinei pe a mana'omia e le masini se tasi.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Leai se faila fa'asalalau na maua i totonu o lenei afifi, o lea e leai se fa'atonuga fa'amafanafana e mafai ona fausia.
terminal_install_no_tool: Leai se SP Flash Tool fausia po'o le MTKClient mea e ulufale ai e avanoa mo lenei metotia.
terminal_install_failed: Le mafai ona tatala se fa'amalama fa'amalama. O le fa'atonuga fa'apipi'i na tusia i le {path}.
status_terminal_install: Fa'atonu le fa'atonu ua tatala i lau fa'amalama fa'amalama ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} o le a tatala nei le ta'avale {method}.

• Afai e le'i pe, tape lou {device}.
• Afai e fa'afeso'ota'i i le USB, fa'ate'a muamua.
{hint}
• Fa'afeso'ota'i lau masini i lau komepiuta pe a matala le fa'amalama {terminal_name}.

Kiliki OK e faʻalauiloa ma alu ese mai Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Motugaafa: Afai e le otometi ona fesootai le masini, oomi lemu le faamau toe setiina i totonu o le pine ma se kipepepe a o fesootai le uaea USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Motugaafa: Tuu lau masini i le faiga o le firmware download (eseese i le faataitaiga: e.g. aveese le maa ma tuu i fafo i le uaea USB e fesootai, pe tape le maa i totonu, pe uu le Volume Down/Up a'o fesootai le USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Faʻapipiʻi e ala i le SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI o le a tatalaina nei ma lau firmware muaʻi utaina.

• I le SP Flash Tool, filifili "Download" mai le pusa pa'ū.
• Kiliki le "Download" faamau.
• Ia mautinoa ua tape lau {device} ma motusia.
{hint}
• Fa'afeso'ota'i le uaea USB i lau komepiuta pe a uma ona kiliki le Download.

Kiliki OK e faʻalauiloa le SP Flash Tool ma alu ese mai Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: A mafai, o autu Rockbox e otometi lava ona faʻafeiloaʻi i le Y1 ma le Y2 pe a maeʻa le faʻapipiʻiina o le Rockbox manuia.
themes_placement_failed_note: Sa le mafai ona matou tu'u le afifi autu i lau ta'aloga. E mafai ona e toe taumafai mai Seti.
settings_rockbox_desc: Fa'aoga pe a su'esu'e fa'asalalauga polokalame.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Fa'aali Original Software fa'asalalauga ua leva atu nai lo le 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
O fa'asalalauga Original Software e sili atu nai lo le 3.0.7 e le fetaui ma iunite Y1 fa'atau atu i le Innioasis OS 3.0.7. O le moliina o se fale tuai i luga o nei iunite o le a taofia ai i latou mai le faʻaosoina seʻia oʻo ina toe faʻapipiʻi se kopi fou.

E te mautinoa e te mana'o e fa'aali fa'amatalaga Original Software ua leva atu nai lo le 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Fa'aali fale o lo'o iai le ROM zip o le 240p variant (rom…_240p.zip). 240p builds e le fetaui ma Y1 units ile Innioasis OS i lalo ole 3.0.7, o lea e mafai ai e Show Old Rockbox Builds.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
O faʻasalalauga o Rockbox-Y1 i luma ole 0.5 e le fetaui ma Y1 iunite faʻatau atu ina ua maeʻa Mati 2026 faʻatasi ma le Innioasis OS 3.0.7 na faʻapipiʻi muamua.

O le moliina o se fale tuai i luga o nei masini o le a taofia ai le taʻavale.

E te mautinoa e te mana'o e fa'aali mea tuai Rockbox fau?
sel_back_to_online: ← Toe foʻi i luga ole Initaneti Polokalame Faʻatonu
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Fa'amolemole filifili se .zip, .rar archive, po'o se faila fa'asalalau (*scatter*.txt) i totonu o se pusa firmware e fa'apipi'i ai lau firmware filifilia i lau {target}.
sel_offline: Lisi i luga ole laiga ole avanoa ile taimi nei. Fa'aoga se faila fa'apitonu'u, pe siaki lau feso'ota'iga.
sel_no_release: E leai ni fa'asalalauga avanoa mo lenei polokalame
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_title: Ua Ma'omia le tele o pusa Firmware
sel_multiple_scatters_error: E tele pusa firmware po'o faila fa'asalalau na maua i totonu o lenei faila/fa'amaumauga. Fa'amolemole filifili se faila po'o se fa'amaumauga e na'o le tasi le pusa firmware i le taimi.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: O lenei faʻasalalauga e aofia ai le sili atu ma le tasi le faila faʻasalalau, o lea e le mafai ai e le Updater ona iloa poʻo fea le faʻatulagaga e manaʻomia e lau tagata taʻalo. E mana'omia e le tagata e fa'atupuina le {software} fa'afou a latou fa'asalalauga fa'amaumau e fa'aaofia ai na'o se faila fa'asalalau se tasi.
sp_search_restart: Leai se masini, toe su'e (taumafai {count}). Taofi le malosi o le tagata taalo ma faafesootai pe a uunaia.
sp_auth_missing_file: E le o maua le faila fa'amaonia ({path}); emo e aunoa ma lea.
sp_config_missing_platform: O le faila faʻasalalau e le faʻaalia lona tulaga, o lea e le mafai ai ona fausia le faʻamafanafanaga mo le faila faʻamaonia; emo e aunoa ma lea.
sp_config_missing_storage: O le faila faʻasalalau e le faʻaalia se ituaiga teuina (EMMC / NAND / UFS), o le mea lea e le mafai ona fausia le faʻamafanafanaga mo le faila faʻamaonia; emo e aunoa ma lea.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Leai se faila fa'amaonia na tu'uina atu; emo e aunoa ma se tasi.
sp_config_write_failed: Le mafai ona tusia le faila o le fa'amafanafanaga; emo e aunoa ma le faila fa'amaonia.
settings_notifications_desc: Fa'aali fa'amatalaga fa'aleaogaina mo le fa'aaliga ma fa'afouga ituaiga o lo'o i lalo. O le tape e taofia mea uma i totonu ole app.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Fa'amalo fa'amatalaga pe a tapuni le app
settings_add_device_type_hint_btn: O le a le ituaiga o ia te au?
settings_add_device_type_hint: Ituaiga o le toe iloiloga meafaigaluega a le tagata taalo. E mafai ona fausia tagata ta'alo o le fa'ata'ita'iga e sili atu ma le tasi - mo se fa'ata'ita'iga Ituaiga A ma Ituaiga B - ma ua faia le polokalama mo se tasi oi latou. Siaki le fasi pepa i tua o le tagata taalo; afai e le ta'u maia se ituaiga, tuu le filifiliga muamua.
settings_add_device_no_versions: E leai ni fa'aliliuga o lo'o avanoa mo lenei polokalame i le taimi nei.
settings_notifications_unavailable: E le'o avanoa fa'amatalaga fa'akomepiuta i lenei komepiuta.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Taofi le app i le lisi o meaʻai pe a tapuni le faamalama, o lea e te maua pea le app ma le player firmware update notifications. Pepe: tapuni le faamalama e tuu ai le app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Taofi le app i le system tray pe a tapunia le faamalama, ina ia e maua pea le app ma le player firmware update notifications. Pepe: tapuni le faamalama e tuu ai le app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Natia le fa'amaumauga a le nu'u i luga ole laiga ma fa'apipi'i polokalame mai faila fa'apitonu'u.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Ua e moliina se 360p Rockbox fausia. E te mana'o e fa'apipi'i le 360p Theme Pack i luga o lenei masini i le taimi nei?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Fa'afeso'ota'i le ta'alo i le fa'aputuga USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Fa'amolemole motusia le USB, fa'aola ma fa'aa'e i totonu o le Rockbox i le taimi e tasi (ona amata ai lea o lona totonu .rockbox system folder), ona toe fa'afeso'ota'i le USB ma filifili le 'USB Storage Mode'.

A faʻafesoʻotaʻi, kiliki Faʻaauau e filifili soʻo se faila i lau taʻaloga.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Filifili soʻo se faila i luga o le teuina o lau tagata taʻalo fesoʻotaʻi
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack ua fa'apipi'iina lelei i lau masini!
sel_themepack_failed: Ua le mafai ona fa'apipi'iina le Pack Theme: {err}
sel_only_local: Filifili se pusa .zip poʻo .rar firmware i le lotoifale, poʻo se faila / faʻasalalau .txt faila, mo le faʻapipiʻiina tuusao, e leai se initaneti e manaʻomia. E galue i so'o se fa'alogo leo Innioasis ma Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Filifili se pusa firmware faʻapitonuʻu (.zip, .rar) poʻo se pusa o loʻo i ai se faila faʻasalalau mo le faʻapipiʻiina tuusao, galue i masini MediaTek lautele.
sel_offline_install: Fa'apipi'i le firmware mai se faila .zip po'o le .rar i so'o se mea fa'alogo leo Innioasis po'o Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Fa'apipi'i le firmware mai se .zip/.rar archive po'o le firmware folder i luga o masini MediaTek lautele.
sel_update_available: O lo'o iai se fa'afouga i le {software} avanoa mo lau {model}.
notices_dialog_empty: E leai ni fa'aaliga i le taimi nei.
conn_offline: O lo'o e leai se initaneti. E le maua mea fa'apipi'i mai le Community Firmware Archive.
conn_online: Ua e toe fo'i i luga ole laiga.
conn_action_online: Maua polokalame i luga ole laiga
conn_archive_unavailable: O le fa'amaumauga firmware e le mafai ona maua mo sina taimi. E mafai lava ona e fa'apipi'i mai le fa'amaumauga po'o faila fa'apitonu'u.
single_instance_title: Ua uma ona tamo'e le fa'afouga
single_instance_body: O lo'o tatala le isi kopi, pe fa'aauau pea i tua. E lua kopi o le a tauva mo le fesoʻotaʻiga USB a le tagata taʻalo, o lea o le a le amataina.
single_instance_focus_failed: E le'i taliina e le kopi fa'agasolo le talosaga e fa'aali lona fa'amalama. Atonu e pisi pe tautau. O le fa'amalosi e tu'u ai o le a fa'alavelaveina so'o se mea o lo'o fa'apipi'iina.
single_instance_force_failed: E le mafai ona fa'amutaina le kopi fa'agasolo. Taofi oe lava, ona toe amata lea o le updater.
single_instance_busy_body: O le kopi o loʻo faʻagasolo o loʻo faʻapipiʻi le polokalama poʻo le talanoa i le tagata taʻalo, o le faʻamutaina nei o le a faʻalavelaveina lena mea. O le a tapunia lenei fa'alauiloa; fa'aoga le fa'amalama o lo'o i ai po'o lana fa'ailoga o le lisi pe a mae'a le fa'apipi'i.
notices_how_community: Fa'afefea ona galue fa'aaliga a nu'u
notices_summary_body: Tatala Faasilasilaga i le app e faitau ai.
toast_battery_charged: A'o le'i fa'aogaina lenei mea i lau ta'aalo, fa'ae'e le maa mo le itiiti ifo ile itula
toast_battery_charged_device: A'o le'i fa'aogaina lenei mea i lau masini, fa'ae'e le maa mo le itiiti ifo ile itula
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Fa'ataga fa'amatalaga tala'aga e maua ai fa'afouga ma tu'uina atu fa'aaliga e tusa lava pe tapuni le Updater i le lisi o mea'ai.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Fa'ataga fa'amatalaga i tua e maua ai fa'afouga ma tu'uina atu fa'aaliga e tusa lava pe tapuni le Updater i le fata faiga.
toast_release_notes_unavailable: O fa'amatalaga fa'amatalaga e le o maua i le taimi nei.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: 'Au'aunaga fa'aliliuga i luga ole laiga e le'o mafai ona o'o atu i le taimi nei pe o lo'o fa'amalo. O fa'amatalaga tu'u muamua o le a fa'aalia.
translate_unavailable_hint: Fa'aliliuga e le'o avanoa mo sina taimi. Siaki lau feso'ota'iga initaneti pe toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
update_store_available_fmt: {new} o lo'o maua ile Microsoft Store (e iai lau {current}).
sel_prepare_done: Ua saunia le afifi, amata le faʻapipiʻi
sel_prepare_failed: Le mafai ona saunia le afifi
sel_notes_hint: Filifili se fa'asalalauga e va'ai i lona changelog
flash_wait_desc: Tape muamua le masini. Afai e feso'ota'i ae le iloa, taumafai se isi uaea USB po'o le uafu.
dialog_pre_install_header: Fa'amolemole ia mautinoa ua tape lau {model} ae le o feso'ota'i i le USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Tape atoa lau masini ae le'i amataina.
• Afai e aisa le masini pe le tali mai, fa'aaoga se pine po'o se kipepepe i totonu o le pu toe setiina e fa'amalosi ai le paoa i le faiga o le download.
• Taofi le uaea USB mo le taimi nei.
• Kiliki Fa'aauau, ona fa'afeso'ota'i lea o lau masini e ala i le USB pe a fa'aosofia.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Aveese atoa lau masini MediaTek.
• Taofi le uaea USB mo le taimi nei.
• Fa'alagolago i le fa'ata'ita'iga, taumafai e fa'afeso'ota'i ma pe leai fo'i se ma'a fa'aofi (pe taofi le Volume Down/Up a'o fa'afeso'ota'i).
• Kiliki Fa'aauau, ona fa'afeso'ota'i lea o le uaea USB pe a fa'aosofia.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: E le mafai ona matou teuina au fa'amatalaga mo lenei fa'apipi'i ona o lau firmware o lo'o iai nei e le'o fetaui ma le Keep Data.
keep_data_help_link: O le a le uiga o lenei mea?
flash_paperclip_explanation: Mo'i ese le uaea USB ma fa'aoga se kipepepe po'o se pine e oomi ai le fa'amau fa'amau, ona toe taumafai lea e fa'afeso'ota'i.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • E fautuaina e faʻafesoʻotaʻi le tagata taʻalo i se pusa puipui mo le 30 minute i le itula aʻo leʻi taumafai e faʻafesoʻotaʻi.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Afai o e i luga ole Windows, ia mautinoa ua e Fa'apipi'i Aveta'avale.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • O Windows PC e tatau ona toe amata pe a uma ona faʻapipiʻi le avetaʻavale aʻo leʻi faʻaaogaina muamua.
flash_keep_settings_option: Taofi a'u faatulagaga ma ala o faasalalauga
keep_data_running_fmt: Ua uma ona fa'apipi'i le {software} i lau {model}?
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Ua uma ona fa'apipi'i le polokalame i lau {model}?
install_first_which_firmware: O le fea polokalame o lo'o fa'agaoioi i lau {model}?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Afai e te le o mautinoa, filifili 'Isi' po'o le polokalama e te manatu ua fa'apipi'i.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Ina ia fa'aauauina lenei fa'apipi'i, fa'amolemole fa'amaonia pe afai o lau {model} o lo'o fa'aogaina le polokalama fa'avae mana'omia ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: E mafai ona matou tausia na'o au faatulagaga ma ala o faasalalauga pe a uma ona fa'aogaina e le tagata ta'alo lenei polokalama po'o se fa'aoga fetaui.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: E faatoa mafai lava ona matou tausia au faatulagaga pe a fa'agaoioi e le tagata ta'alo lenei polokalama po'o se fa'aoga talafeagai.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: E mafai ona matou tausia na'o au faatulagaga ma ala o faasalalauga pe a uma ona fa'aogaina e le tagata ta'alo lenei polokalama po'o se fa'aoga fetaui.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Fa'ataga Taofi Seti ma Ala o Fa'asalalauga i luga o so'o se firmware fa'apipi'i
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Fa'ase'e le fesili fetaui. Na'o le fa'aoga lea pe a e mautinoa o le a fa'aauau pea ona galue le tagata ta'alo i ona fa'atulagaga ma ala fa'asalalau.
err_keep_data_failed: Le mafai ona taofia au faatulagaga ma ala o faasalalauga: e le mafai ona tusia le pusa firmware. E leai se mea na fa'apipi'iina.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Taofi au faatulagaga ma ala o faasalalauga i luga o le tagata taalo. O le isi vaega o le polokalama ua fa'apipi'iina e pei ona masani ai.

support_story_1_headline: A fa'agasolo le au gaosi oloa, e la'a i luga le nu'u.
support_story_1_lead: Puipuia o lau masini mai mailei le leoa o masini ma toe teuteuga.
support_story_1_body: E masani ona taʻavale e le Innioasis ni firmwares fou mo taʻaloga e pei o le Y1 (faʻatatau i suiga o le laupapa natia e pei o le 6.0, 7.0, ma le 8.0) e talepeina lemu masini tuai. O le mea e sili ona leaga, o latou upega tafaʻilagi e maua ai le leai o lapataiga ma leai se avanoa i firmwares galue muamua e toe faʻaleleia mai se tulaga faʻalavelave. Updater ma le Community Firmware project e piki mai vaega: matou te teuina uma talatuu ROM stock, fa'amaonia otometi lau toe iloiloga o meafaigaluega, ma tausia lau ta'aalo saogalemu.
support_story_1_item_1: Fa'asaoina o Tagata Ta'aloga Gausia: Si'itia saogalemu e fa'amautinoa ai fa'afouga fou e le piliki mea tuai.
support_story_1_item_2: ROM Stock Archived: O le aoina atoa o uluai firmwares falegaosimea ua tapeina Innioasis.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Meafaigaluega emo atoatoa mo macOS, Linux, ma Windows tutusa.
support_story_1_item_4: Fa'amatalaga Meafaigaluega: Otometi le su'eina o laupapa ina ia e maua i taimi uma le afifi sa'o.
support_story_2_headline: Leai ni Google Drives malepe. Leai se matematega. Na'o le galue firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Saosaoa, fa'amaonia aseta fa'apitonu'u e mafai ona e fa'amoemoe iai.
support_story_2_body: O le su'esu'eina o polokalama fa'apitoa a le Innioasis e masani lava o lona uiga o le sasaina o fono mo feso'ota'iga Google Drive ua mae'a, o sea o le ao a Baidu ua mate, ma faila zip faalilolilo e leai ni mea e fa'amoemo. Na matou fausia se fesoʻotaʻiga faʻalagolago, tutoʻatasi download ma faʻamaonia SHA-256 faʻamaoni, faʻafouga faʻamatalaga, ma faʻapipiʻi taʻiala taʻitasi. O au foaʻi e tausia saʻo ai le download ma le talimalo lea e mafai ai 24 itula i le aso, 365 aso i le tausaga.
support_story_2_item_1: Fa'asa'o le maualuga-Saosaoa CDN: Saosaoa, tuusa'o download e leai ni tapula'a la'uina po'o so'oga mate.
support_story_2_item_2: Fa'afou Fa'asilasilaga: Fa'ailoa i le taimi e fa'atu'u ai fa'asalalauga fou po'o fa'aleleia.
support_story_2_item_3: Fa'apipi'i La'asaga ta'i-Ta'ilaina: O fa'atonuga va'aia manino e savalia oe i so'o se fa'amau fa'amau.
support_story_2_item_4: A'oa'oga Telegagana: Fa'aigoaina atoa ile Igilisi, Saina, Siamani, Sipaniolo, Farani & Iapani.
support_story_3_headline: Tatala le gafatia atoatoa o lau ta'aloga Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Aumai Rockbox, faiga fa'agaioia mama mama, ma sa'olotoga fa'alogo.
support_story_3_body: Fa'apolokalameina falegaosimea fa'atau oloa na'o le mata'utia o mea e mafai ona fai e lau masini Y1 po'o le Y2. Na aumaia e lo matou nuu le Rockbox, faiga masani fa'agaioia mama, toe fa'afo'i le codec audiophile, ma autu masani i le olaga. Matou te fa'atauina mea fa'apitoa fa'apitoa i fafo o le taga e fa'ata'ita'i ai, toe fa'ainisinia, ma fa'amaonia mea fa'apipi'i uma. Lagolago Updater fa'atupe sa'o nei iunite su'esu'e ma fa'atelevaveina le fa'atupuina o le firmware.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback ma autu masani faʻapipiʻi i sekone.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Fa'aleleia o le ma'a, UI mama, ma le lagolago codec fa'aonaponei.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Matou te suʻeina i masini faʻapitoa aʻo leʻi tuʻuina atu soʻo se fale.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% leai se totogi, fa'alilolilo-muamua polokalama e leai ni fa'asalalauga po'o se siaki.
support_story_4_headline: Fesoasoani mai ia matou faia le mea e le faia e Innioasis.
support_story_4_lead: Fa'asaoina o le firmware e fa'aola e alaalafaga e taofia ai au masini mai uta.
support_story_4_body: A fa'agasolo atu se kamupani meafaigaluega i le isi a latou gadget, e lafoa'ia fa'ata'ita'iga tuai. E le maua e le Innioasis le lagolago a Linux, leai ni suiga manino, ma leai se auala faigofie e toe faʻaleleia pe a le manuia se faʻapipiʻi. O lo'o iai le Updater ona e le tatau i tagata fa'apitoa ona tia'i se mea fai musika lelei atoatoa. 100% o sao fa'alaua'itele e alu sa'o i le fa'aavanoaina o lenei meafaigaluega mo tagata uma.
support_story_4_item_1: Lavea'i & Unbrick: Fa'amaonia le toe fa'aleleia e tafe tusa lava pe mumusu masini e ta'a.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Uluai-Vaega Lagolago: Lagolago atoatoa MediaTek emo i Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Faʻamatalaga faʻamatalaga faʻamatalaga ina ia e iloa tonu le suiga.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Fa'atupe a Nuu: O kofe uma e fa'atumauina pea le fa'amaumauga e tatala ma saoloto mo tagata uma.

err_sp_da_invalid_type: Na teena e le tagata taalo le sui o le download (sese 6104). Fa'aoga le Download Agent fa'atasi ma le SP Flash Tool, ma siaki pe fetaui le firmware ma le tagata ta'alo.

err_sp_enable_dram: E le mafai e le meafaigaluega ona amata le manatua o le tagata taalo. Fa'aoga le afifi na fausia mo lenei fa'ata'ita'iga tonu.
err_sp_storage_read: E le mafai e le meafaigaluega ona faitau le teuina a le tagata taalo. Siaki le feso'ota'iga; atonu e iai se faaletonu o le masini.
err_attempt_timeout_title: E le'i tali mai le masini
err_attempt_timeout: Le mea faigaluega emo e leai se alualu i luma i totonu o le {seconds} sekone, o lea na taofia ai lenei taumafaiga.
err_connection_failed_desc: Le mafai ona fa'atuina se feso'ota'iga mautu ma le tagata ta'alo. Ia mautinoa ua tape le masini (fa'aaoga se pine e oomi ai le faamau toe seti pe a mana'omia), tatala le USB, ma toe fa'afeso'ota'i pe a fa'aosofia.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Ua motusia le emo pe ua le manuia le galuega tusitusi. Siaki pe o mau le uaea USB ma ua lava le tau o le maa, ona toe taumafai lea.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: E foliga mai ua pipii le moli
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Ua fa'aalia e le meafaigaluega moli le laina tutusa mo le {seconds} sekone mulimuli ma e foliga mai e le o fa'aauau pea ona tusia le firmware. Atonu ua le manuia le moli. Afai o le mulimuli lea o taumafaiga e lua i metotia taʻitasi i luga o se faiga e mafai ona toe foʻi i le va o latou, pe afai e naʻo MTKClient o loʻo avanoa i luga o lenei masini, toe amata le komepiuta ma toe taumafai.
err_only_mtkclient_title: Na'o le MTKClient o lo'o avanoa
err_only_mtkclient_desc: Na'o le MTKClient o lo'o avanoa mo lenei fa'apipi'i. Atonu ua le manuia le moli. Faamolemole toe amata le komepiuta ma toe taumafai.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: E mafai foi e lenei komepiuta ona faʻapipiʻi e faʻaaoga ai le SP Flash Tool. Afai e te mafaia, sui ile SP Flash Tool ma toe taumafai.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Atonu ua le manuia le moli. Fa'amolemole faitau le fe'au o lo'o i luga ma toe amata le komepiuta a'o le'i toe taumafai. Afai e te kiliki OK, o le a tu'u le app ina ia mafai ona e toe amata.
err_missing_package_files_desc: O le pusa firmware o loʻo misi le faila faʻasalalau poʻo faila ata manaʻomia. Faamolemole toe la'u mai le afifi pe filifili se faila firmware atoatoa.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: O le faila fa'amaoni na e filifilia o lo'o misi, gaogao pe le mafai ona tusia. Filifili se faila aoga, pe faʻamama i le Faʻamau, ona toe moli.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: E le mafai ona fa'amataina le meafaigaluega emo po'o masini fa'aoga mana'omia. Fa'amolemole siaki fa'atagaga a le faiga, seti aveta'avale, pe toe fa'apipi'i le talosaga.
err_driver_missing_desc: E mafai ona tupu lenei mea sese pe a le faʻapipiʻiina le avetaʻavale MediaTek USB. Kiliki le Download Drivers e fa'apipi'i ai le aveta'avale MediaTek USB, toe amata lau komepiuta, ma toe taumafai.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: O lo'o misi se faila firmware natia. Filifili Filifilia Polokalama e toe fausia faila na aveese mai pe toe sii mai le faila firmware. O se fa'afitauli faila fa'apitonu'u, ae le o se fa'afitauli feso'ota'iga USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Toe fo'i i le Select Software e toe fau pe la'u mai ai le pusa firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Filifili se fa'amalologa firmware e toe la'u mai ai.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Na tupu se mea fa'afuase'i a'o fa'apipi'i ({detail}). Pa'u atoa le tagata taalo, toe fesootai pe a uunaia, ma toe taumafai.
flash_attempt_timeout: Faatalitali mo le tagata taalo… {seconds}s totoe
flash_method_confirm: Fa'apipi'i auala ua suia i le {method}. Fa'amaonia ua tatala le masini ma tape le masini, ona kiliki lea o le Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} e le'i amataina le fa'apipi'i. A uma ona tape le masini ma se'i le pala, {other} o le a fa'aaogaina.
themepack_card_desc: E aofia ai autu matagofie a le alalafaga, pito maualuga pito i tua, ma fonuka na faia faapitoa mo faʻaaliga 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Laasaga 1: Fesoʻotaʻi i le USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Fa'aola lau ta'aalo i le uuina o le ki o le Power.
2. A fa'ae'e le Rockbox, fa'apipi'i le uaea USB i lau komepiuta.
3. Afai e fa'aosofia i luga o le mata o le tagata ta'alo, fa'amautu le USB Storage mode ina ia fa'aalia le masini o se ta'avale.
themepack_step2_title: Laasaga 2: Filifili soʻo se faila i luga o le taʻaloga
themepack_step2_desc: Ona o faiga fa'aoga (pei o macOS) natia dotfiles (pei o le .rockbox) ona o le faaletonu, e mafai ona e filifilia so'o se faila po'o le a'a ta'avale i lau ta'aloga. O le a otometi lava ona matou mauaina pe fatuina le .rockbox directory mo oe.
themepack_complete: Fa'apipi'i lelei le afifi autu! E mafai nei ona e momotu ma le saogalemu lau taʻaloga ma filifili se autu ile Rockbox (Settings> Theme Sets).
themepack_err_not_found: Le mafai ona su'e pe fa'amataina se lisi .rockbox i le ta'avale filifilia. Fa'amolemole ia mautinoa ua e filifilia se faila i lau ta'aloga.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Laasaga 1: Toe amata le tagata taalo ma toe faʻafesoʻotaʻi
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Mo'esea le uaea USB.
2. Toe fa'aola le ta'alo ma tu'u i totonu o le Rockbox.
3. A uma loa le Rockbox, toe fa'afeso'ota'i le uaea USB, ona fetaomi lea o le Fa'aauau.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Laasaga 2: Su'e le tagata taalo ile ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: O loʻo mataʻituina e le app se fesoʻotaʻiga ADB (e oʻo atu i le 30 sekone). Afai e maua se masini, e fesiita'i autu ma toe fa'a otometi le tagata ta'alo. A leai, fa'ase'e i luma ile USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Faatali mo se masini ADB... (e oo atu i le 30 sekone)

rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Leai se masini ADB na iloa i totonu ole 30 sekone; fa'aauau i le USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Leai se binary ADB e maua i le app; fa'aauau i le USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Tu'i autu ma fonuka i luga ole ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Ua le manuia le fesiitaiga a le ADB; toe foʻi i tua i le USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Fa'apipi'i e ala i le USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Fa'agaoioi le USB Storage Mode i luga o le tagata ta'alo ina ia foliga mai o se ta'avale.
2. Filifili so'o se faila i luga o le tagata ta'alo o lo'o i lalo (.rockbox, Musika, Themes, po'o le a'a ta'avale, o se pusa .rockbox natia e tu'u aunoa).
3. O le app e tu'ufa'atasia ai autu 360p ma fonuka i totonu, fa'asolo ai faila igoa tutusa.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Ua mafai nei ona e momotu ma le saogalemu le tagata taalo ma filifili se autu i le Rockbox (Settings> Theme Settings).
